notes: §1985:XII.3.3 SR6: "The implementor must allow a length from 1 through 322 characters for a text word within pseudo-text." ScreenOperandPair refuses (COBOL2572) only a pseudo-text text word longer than MaxTextWordLength (65,535) at every edition, so 1 through 322 are allowed at 85 and the larger 2023 bound is the implementor's latitude above the 1985 minimum. Witness: a 322-character continued word and a 322-character literal as pseudo-text-1 (A, B, C). Probes (classes a, b, f): a 1-, 322-, 323- and 65,535-character continued word compile and run (A); 65,536 draws COBOL2572.

next.reason: 1985: "The implementor must allow a length from 1 through 322 characters for a text word within pseudo-text."; 2023: "The length of a text-word within pseudo-text shall be from 1 through 65,535 characters.". Same subject, REPLACE pseudo-text text-word length, but the bound rises from 322 to 65,535 characters, so longer text-words are now within the allowed range.
